Name: Kiera's Silver Big Chest
Author: addioangel
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8][b]After getting some help from the modding section of the SDV discord, I've finally made my first actual mod![/b][/color]
This is just a simple overlay that makes the lock/metal thing on the big wood chest silver instead of whatever color it was before.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]1 - Download this mod and the other mods it requires[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]2 - Extract the .zip to your Stardew Valley mods folder[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]3 - Finished![/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]BIG, FAT, THANKS to DolphinIsNotaFish for quickly replying to me in the SDV discord and helping me validate the content.json for this mod, this mod couldn't have been made without their help.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]If you have any questions or issues, please dont hesitate to ask about them in the posts tab <3[/b][/color][/size]

Manifest.Name: Kiera's Silver Big Chest
Manifest.Description: Changes the lock on big chests from that ugly gold color to silver.
Manifest.Author: addioangel
